briefing.headline: The soft landing holds as employment tightens and inflation drifts below Fed target.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.6 percent for Sep 2026 sits near the Fed's target, releasing pressure on rates.
Unemployment fell to 4.1 percent for Oct 2026, signaling a labor market still supporting growth.

briefing.whats_new: Today: 10-Year Treasury lower, from 5.12 percent to 5.1 percent.
